{{RV|type=command

|gr1= High Command

|gr2= Event Handlers

|descr= Defines an action performed when player clicked on group marker (3D or in a map). The code executed once.
This EH, unlike [[onGroupIconOverEnter]] and [[onGroupIconOverLeave]], has one more param which returns 1 if RMB was pressed, 0 otherwise.
{{Feature|arma3|Since {{arma3}} v1.58 a [[Arma 3: Mission Event Handlers#GroupIconClick|Mission Event Handler]] exists and should be used.}}

|s1= [[onGroupIconClick]] command

|p1= command: [[String]] or [[Code]] - script

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
onGroupIconClick
{
	// passed values for _this are:
	params ["_is3D", "_group", "_wpID", "_posX", "_posY", "_shift", "_ctrl", "_alt"];

	// before Arma 3
	_is3D = _this select 0;
	_group = _this select 1;
	_wpID = _this select 2;
	_RMB = _this select 3;
	_posx = _this select 4;
	_posy = _this select 5;
	_shift = _this select 6;
	_ctrl = _this select 7;
	_alt = _this select 8;

	_message = format ["____ Info ____"];
	{_message = _message + format ["\n %1", _x]} forEach _this;
	hint _message;
};
</sqf>
